code_summary: Intended architecture: one independently trained MaskedSASRec per category, with separate context (`item_emb`) and target (`output_item_emb`) embeddings. The target table is cloned after initialization without consuming initialization randomness, then jointly trained using 256-negative sampled softmax and the existing item bias. Preserve bidirectional attention, masking, final/auxiliary loss weighting, and checkpoint selection. The predictor writer requires the target embedding in a strict checkpoint load and routes each category to exactly one selected model.
